// diagnostic E0209

Jet.MoveWithoutMarker

A named binding a take parameter receives where the call is not its last use — it is read again later, on a later loop pass, or in another argument of the same call — or a value with cleanup that moves where no `x.move()` is written, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value

What

A named binding a take parameter receives where the call is not its last use — it is read again later, on a later loop pass, or in another argument of the same call — or a value with cleanup that moves where no `x.move()` is written, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value

Why

A call never copies on its own, so a value can be handed over only at its last use, or where its move is written

Fix

Pass a copy with `.copy()`, reorder so the call is the name's last use, or write `x.move()` where a value with cleanup is handed over.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MoveWithoutMarker: Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.stderr.

Error: Jet.MoveWithoutMarker: `core.data.arrow.import` takes `batch`, but `batch` is used again later
  --> Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.jet:4:26
    |
  4 |     _moved: arrow.import(batch)
    |                          ^^^^^
  --> Tests/UI/arrow_batch_use_after_move.jet:5:18
    |
  5 |     arrow.import(batch)
    |                  ^^^^^ `batch` is used again here
 Why: `core.data.arrow.import` takes ownership of this argument, and a call never copies on its own, so `batch` has no value after this call
 Fix: Write `batch.copy()` to pass a copy and keep `batch`, or reorder so this call is the last use of `batch`
